clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Good evening, and welcome to the Filzharmonie Berlin, live on FILZ-TV Kultur.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The Berliner Filzharmoniker are tuned, brushed and lightly steamed. The audience has been asked to cough only in the approved key.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The maestro is approaching the podium. Let us all pretend we have read the programme notes.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Guten Abend. Tonight, the Filzharmonie is sold out, which is remarkable, because the tickets were made of felt and kept fusing together.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: A joyful programme awaits. The second violins have promised to smile, and we have a doctor on standby in case they strain something.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Here comes the maestro. Applause, please, but tasteful applause.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Good evening from the Filzharmonie Berlin. Tonight the orchestra has been told to play with passion, which in Berlin means slightly faster than usual.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The percussion section has been given extra mallets. The insurance company has been given extra paperwork.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The maestro takes the podium. His hair has already started without him.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Welcome to an evening of fire and felt at the Filzharmonie. The fire is metaphorical. We checked. Twice.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The conductor drank three espressos backstage and has asked to be addressed as Maestro Velocity.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Hold onto your programmes. It is about to get vigorous.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Good evening from the Filzharmonie Berlin. The cloakroom has already run out of handkerchiefs.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Tonight’s piece is so melancholy that the orchestra rehearsed it in the dark, holding hands.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The maestro walks to the podium. Slowly. As if carrying all our feelings in a small velvet bag.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Guten Abend. Please switch off your phones, and if you can, your hope.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: It is raining inside the Filzharmonie again. The architects call it an acoustic feature. We call it Tuesday.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Here is the maestro. He has brought tissues for the entire string section.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Bravo! Bravissimo! The audience is on its feet, which is very unusual, because most of them are glued to their seats.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: And yes, the triangle note arrived exactly on time. From all of us at FILZ-TV Kultur: gute Nacht.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: What a triumph. Roses are being thrown at the maestro. One of them was still in a vase.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Coming up next on FILZ-TV: a documentary about the history of the sock. In nine parts. Gute Nacht.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Extraordinary! The orchestra is breathing heavily, and the front row will need new eyebrows.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The maestro has lost his baton somewhere in the brass section. It will be returned by post. Gute Nacht.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Bravo! That was so fast that the echo is still trying to catch up.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Please do not try this at home. Or in Berlin. Good night from the Filzharmonie.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: And so it ends. Not a dry eye in the house, mainly because of the indoor rain.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Thank you for weeping with us. The Filzharmonie will now provide towels. Gute Nacht.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: There is a long, respectful silence. And now, a long, respectful nose-blowing.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: From FILZ-TV Kultur, good night. Please, hug a cellist on your way home.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Listen carefully. You can actually hear the felt.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Exquisite. The violas are playing so softly that some of them may not be playing at all.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Silence now, please. If you are watching at home, kindly put down your crisps.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: And here it comes — the big moment. The maestro’s hair is now conducting independently.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Magnificent! The brass section has reached a volume normally only permitted at airports.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: What power. Somewhere in the second row, a monocle has just fallen into a soup.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: And suddenly, everyone joins in at once, like a family argument, but in tune.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Ah, the key has changed. The triangle player has not been informed.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: A modulation! Very daring. The subscribers in the front row are clutching their pearls.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Please observe the triangle player. Waiting. Ready. Like a coiled spring made of patience.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The triangle player has now been waiting so long that he has started a small family.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The timpanist is in excellent form tonight. We have been asked not to stand near him.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The cellos, warm and noble. Each cello was hand-knitted by a different grandmother.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The double basses, the quiet heroes of the orchestra. Mostly quiet because nobody can hear them.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The harp. Forty-seven strings and not a single one of them has ever been in a hurry.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: A solo! Listen to that. Pure, unfiltered showing off, and we love it.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Our soloist at the piano, playing with tremendous feeling and at least eleven fingers.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: I must point out that there is an electric guitarist in the orchestra tonight. Nobody knows who invited him.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Our soprano is now reaching notes that only dogs and music critics can hear.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The woodwinds, delicate as ever. The clarinet has asked me to say he is fine. He is not fine.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: A gentleman in row twelve has fallen asleep. Honestly, this is the highest compliment in Berlin.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Notice the bowing. Up, down, up, down. They practised this for nine years.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The audience is so moved that someone has started to rain. Indoors. Again.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: Such sorrow. Even the sheet music looks like it needs a hug.

clips.speaker: presenter
clips.text: The tempo is so brisk that two violinists have already finished and gone home.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Good evening, LINT CITY! Welcome to the Monsters of Lint world tour, live on Fuzz TV!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Tonight there will be love, there will be guitars, and there will be absolutely no ironing!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Please welcome, all the way from the back of your sock drawer… THE BAND!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Is everybody feeling fuzzy tonight?! I said, IS EVERYBODY FEELING FUZZY?!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: We have got pyro, we have got lasers, and somewhere back there we have got a very nervous fire marshal!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Make some noise for the band!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: LINT CITY! ARE! YOU! READY?!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: The drummer has been chained to the drum riser for everyone’s safety! The chain is optional! The safety is not!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Monsters of Lint, let me hear you ROAR!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Ladies and gentlemonsters, the amps go all the way to eleven tonight, and then they keep going!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: If you are standing near the front, you will lose your eyebrows! Wear them with pride!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Here they come… THE BAND!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Lint City… tonight we slow it down. Get your lighters out. Get your feelings out. Get your tissues out.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: This one is for everyone who ever lost a sock in the laundry and never got over it.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Please welcome… the band.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Monsters of Lint… it is power ballad time. Even the pyro guy is crying.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Hold the person next to you. If there is nobody next to you, hold the merch.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Lint City, you have been INCREDIBLE! The band will be signing autographs and lint rollers at the back!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Get home safe, drink some water, and do not forget your socks! Goodnight from Fuzz TV!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Make some noise! MORE noise! That is the noise I want on my doorbell!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Monsters of Lint, goodnight!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: WHAT A SHOW! The fire department would like to thank you for your patience!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Encore? You want an encore? Ask nicely! Louder! Goodnight, Lint City!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: That was so loud my ears have filed a formal complaint!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: The drummer is now being gently lowered into an ice bath. Goodnight from Fuzz TV!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Lint City… that was beautiful. I am not crying. You are crying. The pyro guy is definitely crying.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Hug a stranger on the way out. Ask first. Goodnight.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Put your lighters down, folks, the fire marshal is getting emotional too.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Goodnight, Lint City. Call your mother.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Look at that crowd! Lint City, you are UNBELIEVABLE!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Somebody stop this! No! Don’t stop this!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Here comes the drop! Hold onto your felt!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: That is not a drum solo, that is a weather event!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: The drummer has broken another stick! That is fourteen tonight! The forest is in mourning!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Guitar solo! Somebody call the neighbours! Somebody call their neighbours too!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Look at those fingers go! I have not seen fingers that fast since the buffet opened!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: And the bassist… is not smiling. The bassist has never smiled. The bassist is a legend.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Hold on, did the bassist just move? No. False alarm.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Keyboards! Big, glorious keyboards! Every single button is doing something!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Listen to that voice! It is like gravel, but in a good way!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Somebody is crowd surfing! Somebody else is crowd sinking!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Lighters up, Lint City! Phones up! Grandma, put the torch down!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: It has started raining inside the stadium. That is how you know it is a real power ballad.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Shh… this is the quiet bit. The pyro guy is on his tea break.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Key change! Everybody up! Even the security guys are dancing!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: Fire! Fire on stage! On purpose, this time!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: That front row has paid good money to lose their hearing, and they are getting their money’s worth!

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: There is a sign down there that says “marry me, drummer”. The drummer says he is married to the music.

clips.speaker: mc
clips.text: This is the part where you put your hands in the air! Not you, sir, you are holding the beer!

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Good evening, Europe! And good evening to everyone else who is pretending to be in Europe tonight! Welcome to the Eurofelt Song Contest!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: And she is off. Hello from the commentary booth, where the tea is cold and the sequins are everywhere.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Our next act is bringing joy, glitter, and a wind machine the size of a small car!

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: United by Lint! Are you ready for the next act?!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: I have been told this song has a key change. Brace yourselves. Fasten anything that is not glued down.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: EUROFELT! Make some noise for our next act!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: They have brought pyro, backing dancers and a hamster wheel. The rehearsal ended in a small fire. Lovely.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Let’s get this party fluffed up!

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Good evening, arena! Our next act promises an explosion of energy!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Literally. There are eleven pyro cues. The fire brigade is watching from the green room.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Good evening, Eurofelt. And now… something from the heart.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: A ballad. Smoke machine, single tear, the works. Go and put the kettle on now, you will need it.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Please welcome our next act… and pass the tissues.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Our next song is about loss. Specifically, a sock lost in a tumble dryer.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: It is based on a true story. The sock has not been seen since.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: What a performance! The arena is glowing! Europe, you know what to do!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: That was either a masterpiece or a medical emergency. Possibly both. I loved it.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Give it up for our act! Wasn’t that fabulous?!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Glitter in my tea, glitter in my ears. Honestly, I wouldn’t have it any other way.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: WOW! The stage is still on fire! That’s fine! That’s part of the show!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: I’ve lost my eyebrows and found a new appreciation for fire safety.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Our act, everybody! The energy! The pyro! The hamster!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Someone please give that hamster wheel man a glass of water.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: So beautiful. So, so sad. Our act, everybody.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: I’ve gone through four handkerchiefs and the producer’s scarf.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: There’s not a dry eye in the arena. Mainly because of the rain machine.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Absolutely heartbreaking. The juries will either love it or need therapy.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Is she miming? I can’t possibly comment. But the microphone is a banana.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Ah, the key change. The Eurofelt equivalent of a fire alarm. Everyone stands up.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: There it is. The key change. You could see it coming from three countries away.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: And here comes the wind machine. Hair is going places hair should not go.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: The backing dancers are perfectly in sync. Except the one on the end, who is doing a different song.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: There is a man running in a giant hamster wheel. Nobody knows why. Nobody has asked.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Glitter cannon! That’s going to take the cleaners until next year’s contest.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: The pyro budget for this performance was larger than some countries’ entire economies.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: A dramatic pause. And… yes. Sparkles. Of course. Always sparkles.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: The quiet bit. This is where the singer stares into camera three like it owes them money.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Phone voting is open, by the way. Calls cost one felt button. Ask the sock drawer’s permission.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: The band are playing live, apparently. That guitar isn’t plugged in, but it’s the thought that counts.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: There’s a drummer back there giving it everything, bless him, on a drum kit nobody can hear.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: A violinist in a sequinned cape. Bold. Brave. Slightly flammable.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: That piano is on fire. No, sorry, it’s just very shiny.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Big note coming… big note… and there it is. The windows of the arena have filed a complaint.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: The audience is waving flags of countries that, frankly, I’m not sure exist.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: It has started raining on stage. Either it’s the staging or the roof has given up.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Somebody in the front row is crying into a flag. I think that’s the jury.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: This is a lot of energy for nine o’clock in the evening. My tea has started to vibrate.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Isn’t it fabulous, Barnaby?

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Every year I say I won’t enjoy this. Every year I’m wrong.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: And now… it’s time for the votes!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: The most exciting part of the night, if you enjoy maths and suspense in equal measure.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Juries of the Eurofelt, the moment has come! Let’s go to the spokespersons!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Get comfortable. This could take a while, and someone will definitely wave at their mum.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Twelve points! The act is screaming in the green room. Someone has hugged a camera.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Douze points! I think the singer just fainted into a pile of feathers.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Twelve! They’ll be celebrating that back home with a parade and a strongly worded cake.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Ooh. Nothing for our act there. The singer is being consoled by the wind machine.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Not a single point. The green room has gone so quiet you can hear the sequins.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Nul points from that jury. Brutal. Absolutely brutal. Somebody fetch a blanket.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: A few points for our act, there. Respectable. Polite. Very Eurofelt.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Some points for our act. Not the big ones, but they’ll take it. They’ll frame it.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Points are points. The backing dancers are doing a small, cautious celebration.

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: And the winner of this year’s Eurofelt Song Contest is…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Europe, we have a winner! The winner of the Eurofelt Song Contest is…

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: They’ve done it! Our act has won! Next year’s contest will be held in a very large sock drawer!

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Victory! Cue the confetti, the tears, and a deeply questionable reprise.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Ah well. We gave it everything. Mostly glitter. There’s always next year.

clips.speaker: commentator
clips.text: Not this year for our act. But they won the hearts of the arena. And the wind machine’s.

clips.speaker: spokesperson:LNT
clips.text: Good evening, Eurofelt, from beautiful Lintuania! Our jury has argued all night, and our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Lintuania!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:PLY
clips.text: Hello from Polyestonia, where it is very sparkly and slightly static! Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Polyestonia!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:FBR
clips.text: Good evening from Felt Britain! It is raining here, obviously. And our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Felt Britain!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:FLC
clips.text: Greetings from Fleeceland! It is minus thirty degrees and we are very cosy. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Fleeceland!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:VLV
clips.text: Good evening, darlings, from Velvetia! What a night! What a show! Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Velvetia!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:NYL
clips.text: Hello Eurofelt, this is Nylonia calling! Before the points, a little dance. No? Okay. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Nylonia!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:WLG
clips.text: Good evening from Woolgaria! The sheep say hello. The sheep voted too. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Woolgaria!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:DNM
clips.text: Hej from Denimark! We have tailored our votes very carefully. And our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Denimark!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:SMN
clips.text: Buonasera from tiny San Merino! All nine of us watched. And our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: San Merino!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:TWE
clips.text: Good evening from Tweedonia, where we are all wearing elbow patches. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Tweedonia!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:STN
clips.text: Greetings from beautiful Satinsylvania! The castle is lit up just for you! Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Satinsylvania!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:CSH
clips.text: Hello from Cashmeria! Very soft, very luxurious, very excited. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Cashmeria!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:SPX
clips.text: Good evening from Spandexia! We are stretching with excitement! Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Spandexia!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:CNL
clips.text: Hello Eurofelt, from fluffy Chenillia! What a contest! Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Chenillia!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:GNG
clips.text: Good evening from the Gingham Isles, where everything is checked twice. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Gingham Isles!

clips.speaker: spokesperson:FLN
clips.text: Howdy from the Flannelands! We dressed up for this. Our twelve points go to…

clips.speaker: host
clips.text: Flannelands!
